3d_player_controller.subject:
Control schemes, checkpoints and death, save game, NPCs, dialogue and quests, split screen

Zelda and GTA control schemes (PlayerControls.ControlScheme, Player.control_scheme, a Scheme
setting), Checkpoint, KillZone and DeathScreen with Player.respawn_transform, SaveGame with the
Saveable contract (the Player, its inventory and quests, enemies), FollowerNpc, EnemyNpc and NpcCaster
moved in from the host project plus TalkingNpc, Dialogue and Quest resources with DialogueScreen,
QuestLog, QuestTracker and QuestScreen, and SplitScreen with PlayerView for pad-per-player co-op.
